title: JAPANESE SURRENDER ON KOREA
producer: Department of the Navy (RG 428, Moving Images Relating to Military Activities)
year: 1945-09 (NARA date 1945-09-08; the ceremony in Seoul was on 9 Sep 1945)
nara_description: 1) MS Japanese delegates enter throne room of Governor"s palace at Keijo, Korea, for surrender proceedings.2) MS U.S. officers on one side, Japanese officers on other side of conference table VADM. D.E. BAREY (Com. 7th Phib.), ADM. T.S. KINCAID (Com. 7th Fleet), LT. GEN. J.R. HODGE (Com. Gen. 24th Corps), MAJ. GEN. A.V. ARNOLD (Com Gen. 7th Div.) for the U.S..3) MS Japanese delegates sign surrender document (SV) Japanese officers are: LT. GEN. YOSHIRO SOZUKE (Comdr. Gen. 17th army group, Korea), MAJ. GEN. NOBU YUKI ABD (Gov. Gen., Korea) and VADM. GISABURO YAMAGUCHI (Comdr.-in-Chief Japanese naval forces, Korea).4) MS U.S. officers sign surrender document (SV).5) MS Japanese officers rise and stand at attention before table after signing document.6) MS Japanese flag flying from pole.7) MS U.S. troops march on parade ground.8) MS Parade ground Japanese flag flying from pole U.S. troops masses at base of pole.9) MS-CU Japanese flag lowered from pole U.S. flag raised as honor guard salutes cheers in BG motion pictures and still photographers take photograph in FG and BG.10) MS Honor guard of U.S. troops leaves.QUALITY: GOOD
licence: Public domain: US federal government work (17 U.S.C. § 105), filmed by US military personnel on duty; also out of term in Korea (films: 70 years from publication).
not_used: NARA items marked 'Restricted - Possibly' (e.g. the 111-ADC Signal Corps reels) were not used.
